using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;
using System;

namespace DistantLands.Cozy
{
    [Serializable]
    public struct AtmospherePresetParameters
    {
        public readonly Color DayColor => Adjust(dayColor);
        [SerializeField]
        private Color dayColor;
        public readonly Color EveningColor => Adjust(eveningColor);
        [SerializeField]
        private Color eveningColor;
        public readonly Color MorningColor => Adjust(morningColor);
        [SerializeField]
        private Color morningColor;
        public readonly Color NightColor => Adjust(nightColor);
        [SerializeField]
        private Color nightColor;

        public readonly Color SunColor => Adjust(sunColor);
        [SerializeField]
        private Color sunColor;
        public readonly Color MoonColor => Adjust(moonColor);
        [SerializeField]
        private Color moonColor;

        public float saturation;
        public float brightness;
        public float contrast;

        public float lightingIntensity;
        public readonly float StarBrightness => starBrightness;
        [SerializeField]
        private float starBrightness;

        public readonly float LightingAdjustment => (1 + lightingIntensity) * (1 + brightness);

        public readonly Color Adjust(Color color)
        {
            return AdjustContrast(AdjustHSV(color, 0, saturation, brightness, true), contrast);
        }
    }

    public class AtmosphereParameters : IBlendableParameters<AtmosphereParameters>
    {
/*__VARIABLES__*/

        public void Reset()
        {
/*__RESET_FUNCTION__*/
        }

        ///<summary>
        /// Copies the values of the parameters argument to this object.
        ///</summary>
        public void Copy(AtmosphereParameters parameters)
        {
/*__COPY_FUNCTION__*/
        }
        ///<summary>
        /// Blends the values of the parameters argument into this object.
        ///</summary>
        public void Blend(AtmosphereParameters parameters, float weight)
        {
/*__BLEND_FUNCTION__*/
        }
    }
}
